atoms.text: This is Milo the Monkey. He is going to show you around some temperate forests.

instruction.text: Select the photo of a temperate forest.

hint.label: Temperate
hint.text: Temperate is another way of saying not too hot or too cold.

feedback.correct: Great! Forests are areas of land covered in trees and other plants. Temperate forests are forests found in mild climates, just like in the UK.

instruction.text: Select the footpath to learn more about temperate forests.

text: Great! This is Sherwood Forest in the UK. It is home to lots of wildlife, such as foxes, deer and badgers, as well as the legend of Robin Hood!

instruction.text: Select the fallen leaves to learn more about temperate forests.

feedback.end: Great! Temperate forests experience all four seasons, and the trees lose their leaves during the autumn.

instruction.text: Let’s do some fieldwork! Milo wants to find another temperate forest. Answer Milo’s questions.

atoms.a: “Which colour on the map shows a forest?”
atoms.sound: ssml: <voice voiceLang='en' voice='m7'>Which colour on the map shows a forest?</voice>

feedback.end: Exactly! The green areas on the map show forests!

atoms.a: “I have a compass to help us get to the forest. Do you know how it works?”
atoms.sound: ssml: <voice voiceLang='en' voice='m7'>I have a compass to help us get to the forest. Do you know how it works</voice>

b.sound: The needle always points north. You can use that information to work out which way to go.
You add fairy dust and then the needle magically knows which way to point you.

atoms.a: A temperate forest is a forest in a mild climate.
There are not very many animals in forests.
A forest is an area of land covered by trees and other plants.
